question: The objective of the investigation of an accident or incident shall be the:
options: Prevention of accidents or incidents and to help the judges
Prevention of accidents or incidents and to help the manufacturers in design
Prevention of accidents or incidents

question: Which of the following, according to ICAO Annex 13, shall be entitled to appoint an accredited representative to participate in the investigation?
options: State conducting the investigation and State of design and manufacturing
All ICAO member States
Any State which, on request, provides information, facilities or experts to the State conducting the investigation

question: The accident investigation preliminary report shall be submitted to appropriate States and to the ICAO, in:
options: Any of the world's major languages
One of the working languages of ICAO
The language of the investigating State

question: Upon receipt of the notification and a request by the state of occurrence for participation, the state of design and the state of manufacture shall in the case of an accident or serious incident inform the state of occurrence of the name of its representative to be present at the investigation when the aircraft:
options: Has a maximum mass over 100000 kg
Has a maximum mass over 27000 kg
Has a maximum mass over 57000 kg

question: Who is responsible, under Annex 13 of the Chicago convention for the initiation of an accident investigation?
options: The law enforcement authorities of the state in which the aircraft is registered
The aircraft manufacturer
The government of the state in which the accident took place

question: Just before arriving on the apron, taxiing inadvertently on the grass, a wheel falls into a hole which seriously damages the aircraft and obliges the crew to delay departure. This is an irregularity in the operation, the crew must follow the procedure relevant to this case
options: This is an irregularity in the operation, the crew must inform the operator of the delay caused by necessary repair

Since no physical injury has been noticed and the flight is over, the actions to be taken are related only to insurance, to the repair man, the operator and the persons in charge of the runways and taxiways
None of the above

question: Where an accident or incident occurs to an aircraft in India, then the pilot-in-command of the aircraft shall send notice thereof to:
options: AAIB, DGCA, DM and O-I-C of nearest police station, as soon as is reasonably practicable but in any case not later than twenty-four hours
AAIB, DGCA, DM and O-I-C of nearest police station, as soon as is reasonably practicable but in any case not later than forty-eight hours
AAIB, DGCA, DM and AAI as soon as is reasonably practicable but in any case not later than twenty-four hours

question: In the case of an accident the aircraft or any parts or contents thereof may be removed without the authority of DGCA/AAIB:
options: To look for evidence
If so directed by the P-I-C
To extricate the body of a dead dog

question: "An incident involving circumstances indicating that an accident or a serious incident could have occurred, if the risk had not been managed within safety margins" is known as:
options: Reportable Incident
Significant Incident
Flight Safety Incident

question: CVR and airborne image recording data:
options: can be used for disciplinary, civil, administrative and criminal proceeding against the employees, operational personnel or organization
cannot be used for disciplinary, civil, administrative and criminal proceeding against the employees, operational personnel or organization
can be used for disciplinary, civil, administrative and criminal proceeding against the employees, operational personnel or organizations with the permission of DGCA.
